entry.title: VADER 0.10.1 (beta)
entry.summary: VADER for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC): an orbit-based vector synth. Three zips: `VADER-<version>-mpc-sdk.zip` for MPC OS 3.10.1 or later (any MPC or Force, no mod: turn on External Plugin Support and copy the folder into `VST2 Plugins`); `VADER-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` for the 32-bit MPCs and the Force and `VADER-<version>-mpc-aarch64.zip` for the 64-bit MPCs (Live III, XL, One G2, Key G2), both for the Open MPC Plugin Manager or by hand with INSTALL.md (root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod). entry.title: VADER 0.9.2 (beta)
entry.summary: VADER for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC), armv7: an orbit-based vector synth. Unzip, then follow INSTALL.md (root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod). `VADER-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` is the plugin, with example shapes in its `Shapes` folder. How to use it: [the user guide](https://github.com/sunskiefer/VADER/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md). Tested on a device when listed in tested.json (a pre-release until then).
